record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: DUSKULL (1 star), DUSCLOPS (2 stars) and DUSKNOIR (3 stars) declare ABILITY SHADOW_BALL with maxPP 100 and range 2; none declares a passive. All three are DARK/GHOST.
record.summary: Single-target special hit plus a board-wide enemy debuff. The caster deals 30/60/100/200 SPECIAL damage (by caster stars, fallback 200) to the cast target through handleSpecialDamage (AP, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, strange steam and crit scaling, then handleDamage). Afterwards EVERY enemy on the board, not only the target, loses 2 special defense (addSpecialDefense(-2, caster, apBoost 0, crit false), floored at 0 and subject to Twist Band). The debuff is not conditional on the damage landing: it applies even when the target blocked the damage with protect, skydiving or magicBounce.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target; special defense loss: every enemy (team different from the caster) on the whole board
targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the default true. The debuff sweep uses board.forEach and the test pokemon.team != v.team, so it includes the target (if still on the board) and ignores distance.

geometry.shape: single target for the damage; whole-board enemy sweep for the debuff
geometry.detail: No range or radius limit on the debuff: Board.forEach visits every cell in row-major order and the callback filters occupied cells with an enemy team.

effects.scaling: REQUESTED amount is the table value by caster stars. Applied before defence: damage + damage x AP/100 (apBoost defaults true), x2 and the effect consumed when the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE, x1.2 with the strange steam board effect on target or caster, and when the cast crit: x(1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction), where the factor is 1 minus 0.1 per Black Augurite owned by the target's player, and 0 for a Rocky Helmet target.
effects.resolution: The scaled amount is handed to PokemonState.handleDamage (defence, shields, minimum of 1 and takenDamage: see core-mechanics section A; body not re-read here). The whole hit is skipped (returns death false, takenDamage 0) when the target has protect, skydiving or magicBounce; magicBounce additionally reflects a SPECIAL hit back to the caster after 500 ms unless the caster holds Protective Pads, using the target's stars table [0.5,1,2,4] and AP.

effects.target: every enemy on the board (including the damage target)
effects.scaling: Requested -2 with apBoost 0 and crit false, so AP and crit do not change it (factor 1 x 1, rounded). Does not scale with stars.
effects.resolution: APPLIED change: addSpecialDefense runs applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff (for an enemy's negative value it does nothing, because the receiver is not on the caster's team) and then applyTwistBandBuff, which flips -2 to +2 for an enemy holding Twist Band. The result is added to speDef and floored at 0, so an enemy at speDef 0 or 1 loses less than 2 (and the loss is not recorded). permanent defaults false.

starBehavior.note: The caster's stars index the damage table (30, 60, 100, 200; fallback 200). The -2 special defense loss does not depend on stars. Catalog units here are 1 (DUSKULL), 2 (DUSCLOPS) and 3 (DUSKNOIR) stars.

record.positionalConditions: Needs a cast target (requiresTarget true, range 2). The debuff has no positional limit and covers the whole board.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast lowers every enemy's special defense by another 2 down to 0 (permanent false, so only on the simulation copy).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested damage: 30 / 60 / 100 (200 fallback) by caster stars; applied before defence: x(1 + AP/100), DOUBLE_DAMAGE x2, strange steam x1.2, crit factor; takenDamage after PokemonState.handleDamage (defence, shields, minimum of 1) may be much lower and is a separate number. Requested special defense change: -2 on each enemy; applied: reversed to +2 by Twist Band, floored at 0, unaffected by AP or crit.
